tickets.title: Decide where run records live
tickets.body:
Decide whether run records are local scratch or a committed artifact.

Fixture ticket. Created by scripts/branch-harness.ps1. Safe to close.
tickets.comment:
## Resolution

Run records stay under `.claude/caesar-runs/`, gitignored. They are machine-bound and a second checkout cannot read them anyway, so committing them would put a file in the repo that disagrees with GitHub without adding a reader.

GIST: Run records stay in gitignored `.claude/caesar-runs/` scratch rather than being committed, because they are machine-bound and GitHub already carries everything a second checkout needs.
